from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect

    Preconditions: Application server is online and reachable.

    with sync_playwright() as p:

        context = browser.new_context()
        page = context.new_page()

        # Step 1: Navigate to entry view: http://127.0.0.1:8211/
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8211/', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        # Step 2: Populate authorized username
        page.locator('#login-email').fill('demo@harbor.test')
        # Step 3: Populate authorized password
        page.locator('#login-password').fill(__import__('os').environ['VERITYQA_TEST_PASSWORD'])
        # Step 4: Submit login authentication
        page.locator('#login-button').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        # Step 5: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8211/events [Evidence: ev-388285c5]
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8211/events', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        assert '/events' in page.url, f'Expected /events in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Events' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Events'
        assert page.locator('a.brand[href="/"]').count() > 0
